serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: That’s the news I wanted to hear, little one! I knew you could do it! Good job!
You: Thanks!
Big Daddy: Now, without further ado. Show me da picture so we can report that criminal!
You: Sure! I will lay my phone on the table.
Big Daddy: Ah, yes. That’s a good picture. Very good. Weird angle, but he’s staring directly into the lens like a fool! Hahaha!
You: Y-yeah.
That reaction is a little bit uncharacteristic of Big Daddy, he seems weird and his african accent disappeared.
Big Daddy: I can’t believe such a nerd gave us this much trouble, but thanks to you, Anon, he’s done for.
You: I did good, right?
Big Daddy: Very much so! I know it was only a picture, but I was kinda afraid that you would somehow fucked this up.
